authentication_policy: Every remote caller is Administrator-restricted and uses a separately verified private Zoho Connection. Source and arguments contain no credential values.

callers.source_format: Zoho CRM Deluge Standalone function body invoked by CRM Client Script through ZDK

server_function.category_contract_basis: Zoho's current CRM Client Script association contract requires ZDK invocations to target Standalone Functions; the Development Button-category canary produced no CRM Function execution or Catalyst session.

server_side_identity.initialization: domain-separated deterministic opaque assisted journey ID with If-Unmodified-Since
server_side_identity.concurrent_winner_policy: accept the valid authoritative CRM readback without a second write

connection.purpose: inject the exact Catalyst Gateway key and independent Form 1 issue-route header

success_response.url_shape: exact Catalyst Development access URL plus #journeyToken= and one 43-character base64url credential

callers.failure_policy: Fail closed without opening a URL; never log or automatically retry an ambiguous response.

callers.source_format: Zoho CRM Deluge Standalone function body invoked by CRM Client Script through ZDK

server_function.category_contract_basis: Zoho's current CRM Client Script association contract requires ZDK invocations to target Standalone Functions; the Development Button-category canary produced no CRM Function execution or Catalyst session.

deal_initialization.authority: the authenticated CRM function fresh-reads the exact Deal before calling Catalyst

issue_identity.source: derived or preserved only after authoritative Deal read
issue_identity.security_classification: non-secret idempotency identifier; never an access token
issue_identity.expired_restart: an Administrator-initiated launcher invocation derives a retry-stable UUID from a v2 domain-separated digest of the Deal and exact validated prior Setup_Access_Issued_At text, writes it only when different, and preserves Setup_Access_Status as Expired and both historical timestamps until Catalyst establishes a new generation
issue_identity.expired_history_validation: required issued timestamp and optional verified timestamp: strict bounded ISO datetime, Gregorian calendar date, seconds with optional 1-to-3 fractional digits, Z or a numeric offset bounded to 14:00; no locale parsing, whitespace trimming, or equivalent-offset normalization
issue_identity.expired_readback_fence: exact prior status, identity and timestamp text before the single trigger-suppressed write; exact intended identity, preserved status and history before POST; missing, malformed or changed history fails closed without automatic retry

callers.server_side_identity: Freshly reads the journey and immutable Form 2 configuration from the exact Deal and derives separate deterministic UUID-v4 idempotency identities. Deployment_Record_ID must be blank for Journey-core and is never sent.
callers.failure_policy: Only the exact isolated-number precondition failure after exact approval returns approved inactive. Every other activation response fails closed; Journey-core never reports Live.

callers.button: Stop Or Roll Back Free Test
callers.failure_policy: Fail closed and preserve evidence; repeated invocation is idempotent.

prominent_control.label: Start Free-Test Request
prominent_control.policy: Use only supported button order or operator pinning; record which scope was changed. Preserve every active binding and do not invoke the launcher.

lead_legacy_retirement.readback: Reconcile any ambiguous delete before another action. Verify the retired button and exact dedicated Function are absent, the replacement label is prominent in its recorded scope, and its identity, Client Script, Standalone Function, module, layout, profile and enabled state are unchanged.
lead_legacy_retirement.rollback_policy: Permanent deletion has no assumed native undo. Contain a failed replacement by disabling that exact active launcher under existing containment authority and preserving the source-revision hold where active. Do not restore or recreate the retired button or Function, restore exposed credentials, rebind a direct URL-returning Function, or replay consumed evidence. Reintroduction requires a separate reviewed change.
lead_legacy_retirement.historical_label_cutover: The completed two-label migration and its old reverse-rename plan remain historical Git/private evidence, not an executable rollback after retirement.

activation_gates_scope: Historical initial replacement installation gates, using the labels at that installation. They remain prerequisites for a new binding or runtime opening; the legacy retirement neither repeats installation nor reuses any consumed canary or approval.
activation_gates: Verify the exact CRM organization, Development hosts, immutable source SHA, and disabled Production state before rendering any placeholder.
Prove caller-specific Connections expose only the required API Gateway and private authentication headers.

Disable both existing Open Free-Test Setup controls and independently read back that neither control has a direct CRM Function binding before either distinct Standalone Function is created or published.

Publish and read back the exact Standalone-function metadata and module-specific Client Scripts while both replacement controls remain disabled; preserve both other Button-category rollback functions unchanged; the retired local-only predecessor must not be recreated.

Bind each disabled replacement control to only its reviewed module-specific Client Script, prove the exact layout, profile, module, event, source, and no-direct-Function binding, then pass one ZZZ SYNTHETIC Development ZDK function-execution canary for each module-specific Client Script; enable each control only after its own exact function category, state, return type, arguments, details.output response, and navigation readback succeeds.
Run the ZZZ SYNTHETIC Form 1 and mandatory Form 2 journeys, approval, expected fail-closed activation, and idempotent never-active rollback canaries before widening access.
rollback: Disable every replacement control instance by its approved module/button identity before restoring any prior verified active function revision, and preserve their audit evidence.
Independently read back that both module-specific Client Script controls are disabled and have no direct binding to a URL-returning CRM Function.
Keep the failed replacement launcher disabled; do not restore or recreate the permanently retired Form 1 button or its dedicated Function.
Keep Catalyst deployment rows stopped and preserve every configuration, receipt, and route readback.
Never delete historical CRM, Form, Catalyst, or Retell evidence as rollback.
